meta.title: Sistema de abastecimento de água da Grande Florianópolis (CASAN + Águas de Palhoça)
meta.coordinate_note: lon/lat WGS84. confidence: 'documented' = coordinates from CASAN PEC tables or OSM; 'estimated' = placed by heuristic/geocoding of a neighbourhood name.
meta.route_note: Edges with route='estimated' have no public alignment; the app draws a least-cost path (src/core/routing.js) through the listed waypoints. route='documented' means the alignment is described in a public source (road names), still traced by the same router.
